evals.name: two-version-classic
evals.prompt: Compare CRUD performance between 26R1 and 26R2P and write me the comparison doc.
evals.expected_output: Markdown report with Batch CRUD and User CRUD tables (26R1 and 26R2P columns + delta), a Wins/Regressions summary. Numbers must match perfDashboard data (e.g. Batch Create 10 Rules ~12,487 -> ~9,217 ms).

evals.name: three-version-trend
evals.prompt: I want to see how create/update/delete performance has trended across 25R4, 26R1, and 26R2P. Make me a comparison report.
evals.expected_output: Markdown report with one metric column per version (25R4, 26R1, 26R2P) in chronological order, delta vs baseline 25R4, both Batch and User sections, common-runs aggregation.

evals.name: regression-framed
evals.prompt: did 26R2P regress anything vs 26R1? give me the perf comparison report.
evals.expected_output: Markdown report comparing 26R1 vs 26R2P; Summary calls out the User CRUD write regressions (~18-21% slower create/update) and the batch read/write wins. Root-cause section only if opted in (unattended: data+summary still produced).
